note: Johnson County Conservation campground in F.W. Kent Park. Blacktopped pads with picnic table and fire ring, in two wooded loops (North & South). Hosts mid-May to mid-Sep; firewood for sale, playground, storm shelter. Secluded loops set back from the 27-acre lake (not lakeside). --Claude
